session_rubric.notes: No audio. Excellent B11 evidence — systematic graph-to-tree threshold transfer for 5 variables including two-round Salt iteration. Table sorting (small-to-large) observed as novel data inspection strategy. No speech evidence.

B11.note: 5 graph-to-tree transfer instances documented: Energy 215, Fat 10, Salt 0.59 then 0.21, Salt 0.2 (second round), Energy 93. All numeric matches confirmed in observation log. Best B11 evidence in cohort after Boris.

B2.note: Salt underwent two separate movable value iteration rounds (0.59→0.21 in session 1; 0.2 in session 2). Total 6 movable value positions across 3 variables.

B8.note: No audio. All metric reading is inferred from action log (gaze not captured). No verbal label of any metric value. not_measurable.
